pr_body:
The likely cause is that the downsample step wasn't executed, because the index.time_series.end_time index setting was after current time.

Two tweaks to avoid this failure:
* Lower index.look_ahead_time
* Increase wait time in waitAndGetRollupIndexName()

Closes #100271

review_comments:
Hm, is this needed given we configure the start/end time explicitly in the index template to 2021 ?  
``` 
 Strings.format(TEMPLATE, dataStream, "2006-01-08T23:40:53.384Z", "2021-01-08T23:40:53.384Z", policy)
```

The look ahead time would only take effect for the 2nd generation index but we're not writing to it.

But I think the end_time can still be still after the data stream creation? (by `UpdateTimeSeriesRangeService`)
It depends on when it happens, by default it runs every 5 minutes. I think it is possible that the test cluster runs for longer than 5 minutes (many relatively heavy tests in the various test classes)? Especially on slower CI?

Ah, you're right. `UpdateTimeSeriesRangeService` might recompute the `end_time` using:
```
now.plus(lookAheadTime.getMillis()
```
This makes sense - we'll likely have to do the same in other tests too
